sentences.en: And so, look, we feel like we are at a bar or on the couch watching the game together,

sentences.zh: 只是，不，这不一样。

sentences.en: Oh, boy.

sentences.en: I watch every Saturday.
sentences.zh: 我每个周六都会看。

sentences.en: And this timed out perfectly, right, Peyton?
sentences.zh: 而且这次时间安排得非常完美，对吧，佩顿？

sentences.en: Because staying at home, your kids are – are your kids 13?
sentences.zh: 因为待在家里，你的孩子们——你的孩子是13岁吗？

sentences.zh: 是的，他们分别是七年级和十二年级。

sentences.en: And, yeah, I mean –

sentences.en: Boy and girl twins.
sentences.zh: 龙凤胎。

sentences.zh: 就像，就在周一，我女儿下午4点有场排球比赛，我会去现场看。

sentences.en: And then at 5, I'll drive over to my buddy Scott's Garage, which is where I film it,
sentences.zh: 然后5点，我会开车去我哥们斯科特的车库，那是我录制节目的地方，

sentences.en: and do the show at 6.15, and I'm home at 9.30.
sentences.zh: 6点15分开始录节目，9点半我就能到家了。

sentences.en: How did Scott – wait, how did Scott's house turn into the studio?
sentences.zh: 斯科特是怎么——等等，斯科特的家是怎么变成演播室的？

sentences.en: Great quick story.
sentences.zh: 说来话长，简单讲讲。

sentences.en: You know, Scott owed me a favor.
sentences.zh: 你知道，斯科特欠我一个人情。

sentences.en: When you win a football game as a quarterback, you have about 50 texts after a game.
sentences.zh: 当你作为四分卫赢下一场橄榄球比赛时，赛后你会收到大约50条短信。

sentences.en: When you lose, you have three.
sentences.zh: 当你输了的时候，你只会收到三条。

sentences.en: Your wife, who says she loves you.
sentences.zh: 一条是你妻子发的，她说她爱你。

sentences.en: Your dad, who played, says, hey, tough night.
sentences.zh: 一条是你父亲发的，他以前也打球，他说，嘿，今晚真不容易。

sentences.en: I'm proud of you.
sentences.zh: 我为你感到骄傲。

sentences.en: Hang in there.
sentences.zh: 坚持住。

sentences.en: Your other brother who's a quarterback, Eli, hey, you know, some tough conditions.
sentences.zh: 还有你那个同样是四分卫的兄弟伊莱发的，嘿，你知道，条件确实很艰难。

sentences.en: You know, get him next week.
sentences.zh: 你知道，下周赢回来。

sentences.en: What you don't do when a quarterback loses is replay the game in the text.
sentences.zh: 当四分卫输球时，你绝对不会做的事就是在短信里重播比赛。

sentences.en: Like, you don't say, hey, really sorry about those four interceptions.
sentences.zh: 比如，你不会说，嘿，真为你那四次被拦截感到遗憾。

sentences.en: Yes, thank you.
sentences.zh: 是的，谢谢。

sentences.en: I remember.
sentences.zh: 我记得。

sentences.en: I was there.
sentences.zh: 我就在现场。

sentences.en: It was 20 minutes ago.
sentences.zh: 那可是20分钟前的事。

sentences.en: My friend Scott – you know, we've all done this.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友斯科特——你知道的，我们都干过这种事。

sentences.en: Have you ever texted someone accidentally?
sentences.zh: 你有没有不小心给别人发错过短信？

sentences.en: You're talking about them, and you text the person that you're talking about?
sentences.zh: 就是你在聊某人，结果把短信发给了那个被聊的人？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I threw four interceptions against the Bengals one night.
sentences.zh: 有天晚上对阵孟加拉虎队时，我被断了四次球。

sentences.en: I come in, I got four texts.
sentences.zh: 我回来一看，有四条短信。

sentences.en: My dad, my brother, my wife.
sentences.zh: 我爸、我哥、我老婆。

sentences.en: I have a fourth from Scott, who texts and says, hey, do you think Peyton has money on this game?
sentences.zh: 第四条是斯科特发的，他问：嘿，你觉得佩顿是不是在这场比赛里押钱了？

sentences.en: Okay?
sentences.zh: 懂吗？

sentences.en: I mean, we've all been there, right?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们都经历过这种事，对吧？

sentences.en: Do I respond?
sentences.zh: 我要回复吗？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不回。

sentences.en: Do I know it's an accident?
sentences.zh: 我知道他是发错了吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 知道。

sentences.en: Does Scott call me on Thursday to say, hey, my 10-year-old was playing with my phone if you got a weird text?
sentences.zh: 周四斯科特给我打电话说：嘿，如果你收到什么奇怪的短信，那是我十岁的孩子在玩我手机，别介意？

sentences.en: I'm like, all right, Scott.
sentences.zh: 我说，行吧，斯科特。

sentences.en: The fact that you blamed your 10-year-old son, now I have a problem with it.
sentences.zh: 但你把锅甩给十岁的儿子，这我就不能忍了。

sentences.en: So, 10 years later –
sentences.zh: 所以，十年过去了——

sentences.en: Scott's a dirt bag.
sentences.zh: 斯科特就是个混蛋。

sentences.en: I said, Scott, I need your garage, okay?
sentences.zh: 我说，斯科特，我得用你的车库，行吗？

sentences.en: You owe me.
sentences.zh: 你欠我的。

sentences.en: That was mental trauma, so I'm using your garage, and that's how it came about.
sentences.zh: 那对我造成了心理创伤，所以我得用你的车库，事情就是这么来的。

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's tight quarters in there.
sentences.zh: 那里面空间很挤。

sentences.en: The equipment – I didn't know this.
sentences.zh: 这些设备——我之前不知道。

sentences.en: stays there all year.
sentences.zh: 它们一年四季都放在那儿。

sentences.en: I thought it was like, we're going to pop in, and we'll pop out when we come back in a couple weeks.
sentences.zh: 我原以为我们只是进去录一下，过几周回来再用的时候再进去。

sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，我们只做10场比赛。

sentences.en: We don't do all 17.
sentences.zh: 不是全部17场。

sentences.en: I don't want to see Eli 17 weeks in a row via Zoomer.
sentences.zh: 我可不想连续17周通过Zoom看伊莱。

sentences.en: And so, that equipment staying there year-round didn't excite Ashley.

sentences.en: He's a car collector, but that's where it is.
sentences.zh: 他是个汽车收藏家，但也仅此而已了。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I think two games is plenty.
sentences.zh: 不过，是啊，我觉得两场比赛足够了。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我觉得我父亲在场外的事情上给我的帮助，

sentences.zh: 和作为四分卫在场上的表现一样多。

sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他总是说，输了比赛也要接受采访。

sentences.zh: 要给球迷签名。

sentences.zh: 那是你需要磨练的技能吗，比如接受采访之类的？

sentences.zh: 是的，我想是这样。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, you try to, I still say, uh, and you know, too much.

sentences.en: Will and I hosted a couple of friends of ours that are members at another golf course here in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 威尔和我昨天招待了我们的几位朋友，他们是洛杉矶另一家高尔夫球场的会员。

sentences.en: One of whom is a big friend of the show, has done two episodes, a live episode and an in-studio.
sentences.zh: 其中一位是我们节目的好朋友，上过两期节目，一期现场版，一期演播室版。

sentences.en: And so Will had the idea yesterday that we should show up and intimidate them by wearing matching outfits.
sentences.zh: 所以威尔昨天提议，我们应该穿上情侣装去吓唬他们一下。

sentences.en: And so we did.
sentences.zh: 于是我们就这么做了。

sentences.en: We did.
sentences.zh: 我们确实这么做了。

sentences.en: We had blue pants and a white shirt, white shoes, white hat.
sentences.zh: 我们穿了蓝色裤子，白色衬衫，白色鞋子，白色帽子。

sentences.en: Can you say who it is or no?
sentences.zh: 能说出是谁吗，还是不能？

sentences.en: Unimportant.
sentences.zh: 不重要。

sentences.en: But now we're going to their course today.
sentences.zh: 但今天我们要去他们的球场了。

sentences.en: Their course allows shorts.
sentences.zh: 他们的球场允许穿短裤。

sentences.en: Is that guy?
sentences.zh: 是那个人吗？

sentences.en: Yes, it's that guy.
sentences.zh: 对，就是那个人。

sentences.en: So we're going to wear some shorts today, it looks like, Will.
sentences.zh: 看来我们今天要穿短裤了，威尔。

sentences.en: Yes?
sentences.zh: 怎么了？

sentences.en: We haven't discussed our –
sentences.zh: 我们还没讨论过我们的——

sentences.en: So these are the light gray.
sentences.zh: 这些是浅灰色的。

sentences.en: I also have a bit of a darker gray short.
sentences.zh: 我还有一条颜色深一点的短裤。

sentences.en: Do you have any that are your size?
sentences.zh: 你有合你尺码的吗？

sentences.en: No, they all came in a boys' medium.
sentences.zh: 没有，它们都是男孩中码的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是啊。

sentences.en: So why don't we rethink the – no, sit back down.
sentences.zh: 所以我们为什么不重新考虑一下——不，坐回去。

sentences.en: We got it.
sentences.zh: 我们搞定了。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There it is.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: And the Garanimals is that you'd match the top because they're Garanimals.
sentences.zh: Garanimals 的特点就是你会搭配好上衣，因为它们是 Garanimals。

sentences.en: I tell you what, Sean, we're going to go.
sentences.zh: 跟你说吧，肖恩，我们要走了。

sentences.en: We're going to play.
sentences.zh: 我们要去玩了。

sentences.en: And don't worry.
sentences.zh: 别担心。

sentences.en: Afterwards, I'm going to give you the full play.
sentences.zh: 之后我会把整个过程告诉你。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye.
sentences.zh: 再见。

sentences.en: Bye, please.
sentences.zh: 再见，拜托了。

sentences.zh: 干得好。
